description: Readiness regression corpus (T-08). Synthetic Fenre records modelled on the external review's cases, an environment they run against, and the ground truth per requirement. truth values: present (the environment has it), derived (the SPL produces it), alternative (an OR branch another present branch satisfies), missing (genuinely absent). ready says whether the use case would run correctly here.

cases.spl: index=itsm sourcetype=snow:incident priority=1 | eval opened_epoch=strptime(opened_at,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval closed_epoch=strptime(closed_at,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval age_days=round((coalesce(closed_epoch, now())-opened_epoch)/86400,1) | eval sla_met=if(age_days<=4,1,0), open_breach=if(isnull(closed_epoch) AND age_days>4,1,0) | stats count by sla_met open_breach
index=wineventlog sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625 | stats count as failures dc(src) as src_count by user | where failures > 10 AND src_count > 3
index=fw sourcetype=pan:traffic action=allowed | rename src_ip as src, dest_ip as dest | stats count by src dest dest_port
index=auth sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" | rex field=_raw "for (invalid user )?(?<username>\S+) from (?<src>\S+)" | stats count by process username src
index=app sourcetype=app:json | spath input=payload path=event.type output=event_type | spath input=payload path=actor.id output=actor_id | stats count by event_type actor_id
index=fw sourcetype=pan:traffic | lookup asset_inventory ip as dest_ip OUTPUT owner criticality | where criticality="high" | stats count by owner dest_ip
index=itsm (sourcetype=snow:incident OR sourcetype=snow:sc_req_item) | stats count by assignment_group
index=itsm sourcetype IN ("snow:incident", "snow:sc_req_item") state=7 | stats count by priority
index=ot (sourcetype=modbus:traffic OR sourcetype=dnp3:traffic) | stats count by unit_id
index=dhcp sourcetype=infoblox:dhcp | stats latest(dest_mac) as mac by dest_ip | join type=inner dest_ip [search index=fw sourcetype=pan:traffic | stats count by dest_ip]
index=vpn sourcetype=cisco:asa action=failure | stats count by user | append [search index=dhcp sourcetype=infoblox:dhcp | stats count by user]
| multisearch [search index=vpn sourcetype=cisco:asa] [search index=ot sourcetype=modbus:traffic] | stats count by user

cases.pattern: field read before it is produced
cases.spl: index=wineventlog sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4720 | eval account=lower(TargetUserName) | stats count by account

cases.pattern: idle sourcetype outside the sampling window
cases.spl: index=idle sourcetype=cisco:ise:syslog | stats count by user NAS_IP
index=vpn sourcetype=cisco:asa | stats count by user src
index=fw sourcetype=pan:traffic | stats sum(bytes) as total by src_ip
index=vpn sourcetype=cisco:asa | bin _time span=1h | stats count by _time user | eventstats avg(count) as avg_count by user | where count > 3*avg_count
